_note: New actor, first pricing entry. Market (2026-10-09): clearpath/welcome-to-the-jungle-jobs-api $0.00299 per item (178 monthly users), shahidirfan/Jungle-Job-Scraper tiered (61), bebity (30), memo23 (15). job $0.002 from the search index; job_detail $0.003 with the job API read (full description, skills, apply link). No start fee. No proxy: the site's Algolia index and job API answered Apify IPs in the 2026-10-09 probe.

job.eventDescription: One Welcome to the Jungle job with title, company (size, sector, founded year, logo), offices and coordinates, contract, remote policy, salary range, experience, education, profession, missions, requirements summary and URL. A search with no results is free.

job_detail.eventDescription: The same job plus its full description, requirements, hiring process, skills, tools, street address, start date and apply link, read from the job page. Only with Full description on; charged instead of Job, not on top of it.
